instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height with elbows bent.
2. Keep a slight bend in your knees and a flat back.
3. Hinge at the hips, pushing your hips back and lowering your torso toward the floor.
4. Stop when your torso is almost parallel to the floor and you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
5. Drive your hips forward to raise your torso back to standing.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your back flat and do not round your spine.
2. Hinge at the hips, not the waist.
3. Keep a slight bend in your knees throughout.
4. Brace your core before each rep.
name: Good mornings dumbbells

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell with both hands at chest height.
2. Keep a slight bend in your knees and a flat back.
3. Hinge at the hips, pushing your hips back and lowering your torso toward the floor.
4. Stop when your torso is almost parallel to the floor and you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
5. Drive your hips forward to raise your torso back to standing.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your back flat and do not round your spine.
2. Hinge at the hips, not the waist.
3. Keep a slight bend in your knees throughout.
4. Brace your core before each rep.
name: Good mornings kettlebell

instructions:
1. Position your shoulders under the pads and place your feet shoulder-width apart on the platform.
2. Press your back flat against the backrest and release the safety handles.
3. Bend your knees to lower your body until your thighs are parallel to the platform.
4. Push through your heels to extend your legs and return to the start.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your back pressed against the backrest throughout.
2. Track your knees over your toes.
3. Exhale as you press up and inhale as you lower.
4. Control the descent rather than dropping.
name: Hack Squat Machine Squat

instructions:
1. Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders and body in a straight line.
2. Jump both feet forward toward your hands into a squat position.
3. Jump both feet back to return to the high plank.
4. Keep your core braced and body straight throughout.
5. Repeat at a steady pace.
tips:
1. Keep your hands directly under your shoulders in the plank.
2. Brace your core to keep your hips from sagging.
3. Exhale as you jump forward, inhale as you reset.
4. Use a non-slip surface to keep your hands and feet stable.
name: Half burpees

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart on the middle of the resistance band.
2. Hold a handle in each hand with palms facing each other, arms extended down at your sides.
3. Curl both handles up toward your shoulders by bending your elbows, keeping palms facing each other.
4. Slowly lower the handles back to full arm extension.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your elbows close to your body and do not swing.
2. Control the lowering phase against the band tension.
3. Squeeze at the top where band tension peaks.
4. Exhale as you curl up, inhale as you lower.
name: Hammer curl Resistance band simultaneous
